text:
Matt (AE): Kicking off POC with Fletcher Health — 2 week eval window. They want: hosted API, customer-managed KMS, streaming transcripts, structured JSON output, and function/tool calling for EHR lookups. Need SE + security help. Major blockers: SOC2 evidence, CMEK integration, and pricing for steady traffic.

Jin (SE): 👍 I can lead the tech POC. Quick question — do they require VPC/private deployment or will hosted with CMEK and IP allowlist suffice? Also what's their expected sustained qps?

Matt (AE): They prefer hosted if we can satisfy CMEK + audit logs. Expected peak ~220 req/s during business hours; avg lower. They want demo showing `tool_call` for patient record lookup and structured output for downstream ingestion.

Sarah (Presales): I'll pull pricing estimates. If sustained qps ~200+, we should surface a reserved capacity option vs pay-as-you-go. Ping pricing; I'll need a ballpark for 200–500 qps with streaming (avg 512 tokens).

Jin (SE): For perf, our numbers on A100-ish infra: ~12–14ms per token at 512 tokens for batched streams (example workload). For the POC I'll prepare a lightweight harness. Sample SDK snippet for streaming + toolcall: 

```js
// pseudo-code for real-time stream with function call handling
const stream = client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-rlm', stream: true });
stream.on('data', (chunk) => console.log(chunk));
const resp = await client.chat.create({
  messages: [{role: 'user', content: 'Fetch latest med summary for patient 1234'}],
  tools: [{ name: 'ehr_lookup', url: 'https://ehr.internal/fetch' }],
  response_format: { type: 'json', schema: { summary: 'string', meds: ['string'] } }
});
```

Jin (SE): For structured output, use the `response_format` enforcement and include validation in the SDK to fail-fast on schema mismatches. I'll attach a small runbook with sample payloads.

Deepti (Security): Heads-up: their security questionnaire flagged three items: CMEK/CMEK key control, network isolation, and audit/traceability. We can answer: 1) CMEK: we support CMEK with GCP KMS/Azure KeyVault/AWS KMS; if they require HSM-backed keys we need details (cloud HSM supported, on-prem HSM not out-of-the-box). 2) Network: for hosted, we offer IP allowlist + private peering for enterprise (requires Dedicated/Private deployment). 3) Audit logs: we can provide per-request logs with PII redaction and retention controls.

Deepti (Security): Also confirm SSO (SAML) requirements and whether they need tenant isolation for logs. If they insist on no egress of decrypted data to cloud providers, we may need a Private deployment.

Matt (AE): They asked about SSAE/SOC2 evidence — what's the process?

Deepti (Security): We have SOC2 report available under NDA. Legal can push DPA and security addendum. I'll own the questionnaire responses. Please share the questionnaire doc.

Sarah (Presales): Action items from presales side: 1) Pricing draft for reserved bucket + burst 2) Demo key + sample dataset (anonymized) 3) Runbook + SDK samples (Jin) 4) Security Q responses & SOC2 (Deepti) 5) Decide hosted vs Dedicated based on CMEK/HSM needs (Matt).

Jin (SE): Proposed POC plan (ETA 3 business days to first demo):
- Day 0: get sample data + security Q
- Day 1: provide SDK example + structured-output demo (local)
- Day 2: provision demo key + run small load test (50–250 qps) and capture latency numbers
- Day 3: live demo with function-calls + handoff doc
I'll include a tiny postman/insomnia collection and a Docker-based local runner.

deploy-bot: demo-env created: redwood-demo-fletcher-2026 (expires in 14 days). Credentials shared in 1:1.

Deepti (Security): I'll fill the security questionnaire by EOD tomorrow and attach our standard answers for CMEK and logging. If they require HSM onsite, mark as blocker for hosted.

Matt (AE): Great — I'll send the questionnaire and anonymized sample dataset now. I'll loop in their infra lead for a short sync. Thanks all :thumbsup:

Jin (SE): On it. Will post the SDK snippets and the runbook link here once ready.

Sarah (Presales): I'll chase pricing and have a draft by EOD.

Deepti (Security): Added the questionnaire to the shared drive and started draft answers.

Matt (AE): Next sync scheduled Tue 10am PT.
